verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is a knowledge-base feature of an agent framework, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows in-framework agent tools such as `knowledge_list`, a Studio page, and llms.txt/markdown docs. None of it documents an official MCP server or endpoint for connecting external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
